items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Oh, I don't know, I don’t know, I just never took count of those things.

Yeah, I did that. I didn't do much, I think I subbed for Frank Perkins a few times while he was ill, he was having an operation of some kind, but that was his show. He's the guy who wrote, “Stars Fell on Alabama.”
